message:
## Vulnerability Digest

Four high-confidence product developments were verified in the 24-hour scan window. Immediate review is recommended for the critical WordPress core issue, Chrome's 108-fix release, two SolarWinds Observability Self-Hosted RCEs, and the critical/high items in a newly published RabbitMQ CVE batch.

**Scope**

- Sources: `Products.txt` and `List_of_SIA_Completed.txt` only; obvious aliases, capitalization variants, and duplicates were normalized.
- `DLL_software_component.txt` was not read or combined with this scan.
- Window: 2026-09-23 05:10 IST through 2026-09-24 05:10 IST (2026-09-22 23:40 UTC through 2026-09-23 23:40 UTC).

**Finding 1: WordPress core conditional remote code execution**

- Product: WordPress
- Issue: CVE-2026-87902 / GHSA-7hp8-65ch-5whp
- Severity: Critical, CVSS 9.2
- Description: An unauthenticated attacker can make page-template resolution include a readable local PHP file outside the active theme directories; under documented theme/server preconditions, this can lead to remote code execution.
- Relevance: Direct match to the monitored WordPress product. Affected maintained and backported branches precede 7.1.2, 7.0.6, 6.9.9 and the corresponding fixed releases down to 4.7.37.
- Source: [WordPress release](https://wordpress.org/news/2026/09/wordpress-7-1-2-release/); [GitHub vendor advisory](https://github.com/WordPress/wordpress-develop/security/advisories/GHSA-7hp8-65ch-5whp); [CERT-In note](https://www.cert-in.org.in/s2cMainServlet?VLCODE=CIVN-2026-0472&pageid=PUBVLNOTES01)

**Finding 2: Google Chrome 154 security release**

- Product: Google Chrome
- Issues: 108 security fixes, including critical CVE-2026-95350, CVE-2026-95357, CVE-2026-95339, CVE-2026-95281, and CVE-2026-95313
- Severity: Critical for the five named issues; the release contains additional severities
- Description: Google fixed memory-corruption flaws including buffer overflows, out-of-bounds writes, and use-after-free conditions across ANGLE, GPU, ServiceWorker, and Fullscreen, plus numerous other browser issues.
- Relevance: Direct match to Google Chrome. Fixed builds are 154.0.8037.57 on Linux and 154.0.8037.57/.58 on Windows and macOS.
- Source: [Google Chrome Releases](https://chromereleases.googleblog.com/2026/09/stable-channel-update-for-desktop_0856730748.html); [CERT-FR advisory](https://www.cert.ssi.gouv.fr/avis/CERTFR-2026-AVI-1213/)

**Finding 3: SolarWinds Observability Self-Hosted remote code execution**

- Product: SolarWinds Observability Self-Hosted
- Issues: CVE-2026-28324 and CVE-2026-28325
- Severity: Critical (CVE-2026-28324, CVSS 9.8) and High (CVE-2026-28325)
- Description: Two unauthenticated RCE flaws affect specific non-default communication configurations, one involving insufficient integrity checks and the other unsafe deserialization.
- Relevance: The inventory explicitly monitors SolarWinds. Observability Self-Hosted 2026.2.2 and earlier is affected; 2026.2.3 contains the fixes.
- Freshness: The vendor records are dated 22 September; CERT-FR issued a new advisory on 23 September inside this run's window.
- Source: [CERT-FR advisory](https://www.cert.ssi.gouv.fr/avis/CERTFR-2026-AVI-1215/); [SolarWinds CVE-2026-28324](https://www.solarwinds.com/trust-center/security-advisories/cve-2026-28324); [SolarWinds CVE-2026-28325](https://www.solarwinds.com/trust-center/security-advisories/cve-2026-28325)

**Finding 4: RabbitMQ CVE publication batch**

- Product: RabbitMQ Server
- Issues: CVE-2026-66067, CVE-2026-66068, CVE-2026-66069, CVE-2026-66070, CVE-2026-66072, CVE-2026-66074, CVE-2026-66075, CVE-2026-66076, CVE-2026-66077, CVE-2026-66079, CVE-2026-66080, CVE-2026-67218, CVE-2026-67219, CVE-2026-67220, CVE-2026-67221, CVE-2026-67224, CVE-2026-67228, CVE-2026-67229, CVE-2026-67231, CVE-2026-67232, CVE-2026-67235, CVE-2026-67238, CVE-2026-67240, CVE-2026-67404, and CVE-2026-67405
- Severity: Critical through Low. Highest priority includes CVE-2026-67404 and CVE-2026-67231 (Critical); CVE-2026-66070, CVE-2026-66077, CVE-2026-66079, CVE-2026-67232, CVE-2026-67235, and CVE-2026-67238 are High.
- Description: The batch covers TLS/JWKS verification bypasses, management and cross-vhost authorization gaps, credential/log disclosure, stored/reflected XSS, atom-table and memory exhaustion, decompression and message-size denial of service, and Web-STOMP/Web-MQTT origin validation.
- Relevance: Direct match to RabbitMQ. Affected and fixed versions differ by CVE; many are corrected across 3.13.15/17, 4.0.20/22, 4.1.11/13, 4.2.6/7, and 4.3.0/1.
- Freshness: CVE records were published on 23 September inside the scan window; several underlying GitHub advisories were prepared earlier, so this is a new-record publication batch rather than a claim that every underlying fix first shipped today.
- Source: [RabbitMQ security advisories](https://github.com/rabbitmq/rabbitmq-server/security/advisories); [RabbitMQ release information](https://www.rabbitmq.com/release-information); [recent CVE records](https://cve.report/)

**Possible matches needing review**

Red Hat published multiple 23 September CVE records for Ansible Automation Platform's automation-controller, including CVE-2026-84719, CVE-2026-84714, CVE-2026-84706, CVE-2026-84691, CVE-2026-84683, CVE-2026-84502, CVE-2026-84486, and CVE-2026-84474. The monitored item says “Ansible,” but these records name Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform rather than upstream `ansible-core`; confirm whether AAP/Automation Controller is deployed before treating them as applicable. [Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform security page](https://access.redhat.com/products/red-hat-ansible-automation-platform/)

**MongoDB ecosystem verification**

The dedicated sweep checked MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, mongod, mongos, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, mongosh, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, official drivers and connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations, and major MongoDB-maintained libraries. No credible MongoDB-family advisory was published or updated inside this run's window; MongoDB's latest authoritative alerts surfaced by the search predate the window. [MongoDB alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts)

**Review priority**

Prioritize WordPress patch validation, Chrome 154 rollout, SolarWinds Observability Self-Hosted 2026.2.3 exposure checks, and the critical/high RabbitMQ items. Review the Ansible Automation Platform records only after confirming that the monitored “Ansible” entry includes AAP/Automation Controller.
